title.narrative: Output 1.3. Increased institutional capacity of labour administrations

description.narrative: The Ministry of Labor and Employment (MOLE) under the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) prepared a plan of action to improve the quality of its labour administration and labour inspection services, taking into account relevant international labour standards, including Labour Administration Convention, 1978 (No.150). The ILO carried out a labour administration and inspection needs assessment (August-September 2021) at the request of the Ministry to assess the current MOLE structures, functions, staffing and services in light of international standards and good practice. This assessment and its subsequent report included recommendations on how to strengthen the labour administration and inspection systems in BARMM to deliver on its decent work mandate in this newly established autonomous region. The recommendations guided the development of the plan of action, which serves as a basis for developing further ILO technical assistance in BARMM in contribution to the goals of the Decent Work Country Program for the Philippines.
